change.item: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.

Settings renamed for clarity: labels is now label_language, pad is pad_numbers, color is number_color, color_custom is number_color_custom and separator is show_separator. Older layouts are migrated automatically when they load, dynamic content mappings included.

Label Language offers Page language (the default) or English. The Malay option is gone: labels come from the language files in the page's language, so a Malay page shows Malay labels. Layouts that chose Malay switch to Page language automatically.

fix.item: Every day mode stays on the chosen time across daylight saving time changes in the site's time zone (it used to add a fixed 24 hours).
The script only watches the page for replaced elements inside the builder preview, not on every page view.
Number Color only accepts its own options.

change.item: Day, hour, minute and second labels come from the plugin's language files (English and Malay), so other languages can be added with Joomla's Language Overrides.

addition.item: First release: count down to a date and time in the site's time zone, to a time every day, or an evergreen countdown that starts on each visitor's first visit (and can start again). Plain, boxes, progress circles or flip cards, a choice of units, labels in Malay or English, and when time is up hide the countdown, show a message or go to a page.
